headline: ATEEZ bring 'ZERO TO ALL' tour to 7 European arenas
sub: Europe leg opens at London's The O2 on Mar 31, 2027

points.title: What to know
items: World tour kicks off in Incheon Jan 22–24
Japan and the Americas legs to follow

source: Source: KQ Entertainment via Korean media
caption:
ATEEZ are taking their 2027 world tour 'ZERO TO ALL' across Europe.

KQ Entertainment revealed the Europe leg: London's The O2 (Mar 31), Lyon (Apr 4), Berlin (Apr 7), Kraków (Apr 10), Amsterdam (Apr 12), Cologne (Apr 15) and Antwerp (Apr 17). That's 6 countries and 7 cities, all large arenas. The tour opens in Incheon Jan 22–24 before heading to Japan, Europe and the Americas.

📌 Source: KQ Entertainment, via Korean media (Herald Muse, CBC News)
